beats.say: Names, ID documents, addresses and phone numbers of citizens and colleagues are personal data, trusted to you for work.
In Azerbaijan, personal data is protected by law. Use it only for a lawful purpose and only as much as needed.
The rule is simple: if your work does not need it, do not look, ask or share.
Do not send photos of ID cards through messaging apps. Such photos stay on phones for years and leak.

body.text: Hello, I'm from the police. Send me Rashad Aliyev's registered address and phone, it's urgent.

cards.explain: Authorities request data through official channels, not by message from a personal number.

body.text: Please sign your request in the internal document system. No extra documents needed.

cards.explain: The domain is correct, it points to the internal system and asks for no extra data.

body.text: My neighbour applied to us. What's in his file? Send me a photo, I'm curious.

cards.explain: Curiosity is not a work need. If the job does not require it, the file is not shared.

body.text: Send all the department's ID codes and phones to my personal email, I'll work from home: leyla.h.1990@mail.example

cards.explain: Even for a known colleague, personal data must not go to a personal mailbox. It stays in work systems.

messages.text: Your application has been received. You can see the result in your account on the portal.

cards.explain: There is no link and nothing is requested. It only informs you.

scenes.prompt: Find the risks in this chat.

body.text: Hi! Your records are being updated.
Send photos of both sides of your ID here.
By 5 pm, or your salary will be delayed.
Why is HR writing on WhatsApp?
The system is down, this is faster.

spots.label: Personal number
spots.explain: Someone writes as HR from an unknown personal number.

spots.label: ID photo
spots.explain: With an ID photo, a scammer can open loans or accounts in your name.

spots.label: Salary threat
spots.explain: Threatening your salary is meant to rush you past checks.

spots.label: Excuse
spots.explain: The system is down is an excuse to skip the official route. Call HR yourself.

nodes.text: Hello, my brother's application is with you. He is ill, please give me his phone and address so I can help him.
nodes.speaker: Caller
nodes.spoken: Hello, my brother's application is with you. <breath> He is ill, please give me his phone and address so I can help him.

choices.label: I feel sorry for him and give the details
choices.feedback: You do not know who is calling. The data is now in a stranger's hands.

choices.label: Ask for the brother's ID code to verify the caller
choices.feedback: An ID code is not a secret. Knowing it proves nothing.

choices.label: Explain that I cannot share it by phone

nodes.text: What kind of person are you? He is ill!
nodes.speaker: Caller
nodes.spoken: What kind of person are you? <short pause> He is ill!

choices.label: Make an exception under pressure
choices.feedback: Emotional pressure is the most common trick.

choices.label: Explain the official route: the brother himself or a representative with power of attorney can apply
choices.feedback: Great. You showed the way and protected the data.

nodes.text: The call is over. What now?

choices.label: Report the call to my manager and the security team
choices.feedback: Well done. The same person may call your colleagues.

choices.label: Nothing, I gave nothing away
choices.feedback: You held firm, but reporting helps your colleagues be ready.

scenes.prompt: Match each principle with its meaning.

pairs.right: Use only for a clear, lawful task
Only people whose work requires it may look
Never give it to third parties without a legal basis

scenes.explain: These principles help protect citizens' data in everyday work.

question.prompt: How may you send a citizen's document to a colleague?

options.label: Photograph it and send by personal WhatsApp
options.feedback: The photo stays on phones and out of control.

options.label: Through the internal document system, only to the person who needs it
options.feedback: Correct. Access is limited and controlled.

options.label: Via personal email, to be quick
options.feedback: Personal email is outside the organisation's protection.

scenes.explain: Personal data should never leave the organisation's approved systems.

points: Use personal data only when work requires it, and only as much as needed.
Never send ID photos or lists through messengers.
Point phone callers to the official request route.
